name: Dual Littlestone Dimension of Half-intervals
details: For the catalogue convention $\mathcal I_n=\{[i]:1\le i\le n\}$ on $[n]$.
proof: The dual consists of the $n$ terminal segments $\{i,\ldots,n\}$, $1\le i\le n$. Querying an index at a median endpoint splits the remaining $m$ consecutive possible endpoints into groups of sizes $\lfloor m/2\rfloor$ and $\lceil m/2\rceil$. Recursing gives a complete tree of depth $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor$, including depth zero for $n=1$. Conversely a depth-$d$ shattered tree requires $2^d$ distinct terminal segments, so $d\le\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor$.
references: Direct dualization of the standard threshold-tree calculation in \cite{littlestone1988learning}.
